title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17

ai_review.summary: Great soundboard recording marred by multiple edit cuts, especially a missing section of Fire on the Mountain
ai_review.review: The SBD captures an otherwise excellent performance with clear audio, but several abrupt edits—including a severe cut in Fire on the Mountain and other song interruptions—significantly disrupt the listening experience. While reviewers praise the overall show quality, the technical flaws keep this from being a fully enjoyable release.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is rated highly by reviewers, but extensive cuts and missing sections lower the overall enjoyment; weighting 70% show (≈4) and 30% recording (≈2) yields ~3.4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear sound for most of the set, but many abrupt cuts: Minglewood, Tennessee Jed solo, Scarlet Begonias, Fire on the Mountain (missing third verse and beyond), intro missing, small gap at end of The Wheel. These edits break continuity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Generally good flow but disrupted by several edit points that truncate songs.
